the use of plants for cosmetics is still a very important practice in the South Western Nigeria.
the most common cosmetic plants used by the people of South West Nigeria are the plants from the families Fabaceae, Asteracea, and Euphoriaceae.
folklore phytocosmetic preparations are still being used in South West Nigeria.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of the plants used as folklore cosmetic in South West Nigeria, the parts of the plant used, and the part(s) of body where the preparations are applied.
the documentation of phytocosmetics used in South West Nigeria and the plants used in the preparations.
the ethnobotanical study of phytocosmetic preparations used in South West Nigeria.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of plants for cosmetic purpose in South West Nigeria has not been completely lost.
the study of the folklore cosmetics in South West Nigeria is an essential step in the preservation of the cultural heritage and traditional knowledge of these plants.
phytocosmetics have a long history of use as a cosmetic and a therapeutic agent in the treatment and/or prevention of skin diseases.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the study is able to identify the various plants used in folklore cosmetics and the various parts of the body that these preparations are applied.
folklore phytocosmetic plants in South West Nigeria are mainly used for skin care and hair growth and that the plants have been used by the people in the study area since time immemorial.
folklore phytocosmetic preparations are still being used in Nigeria, and this is a good indication that the knowledge is still being transmitted from generation to generation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of plants in cosmetics is a common practice in South West Nigeria and that the plants are mostly used to treat various skin diseases and to beautify the body.
the use of phytocosmetic preparations is still very common among the rural communities in South West Nigeria and that the knowledge of these preparations is being passed down through generations.
